Synthetic engineering acceptance fixture. These are scenario assumptions, not measured industry facts.

Section 1: A test rack contains 10 servers. Each server is assumed to consume 300 W at the stated test condition. The assumed server subtotal is 3000 W. This excludes networking, storage, cooling and power conversion losses. Do not call this rack total power.

Section 2: The fixture supplies no load curve, ambient temperature, redundancy policy or measured efficiency. A reader must retain these unknowns and must not infer production capacity or an annual electricity bill.

Final section END: Preserve this tail paragraph. Reading this document creates candidate observations only. It provides no independent verification and does not authorize adopting any research fact.
